newsitem.title: UK: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to June 8.
newsitem.headline: European Diary for Advertising & Media - to June 8.

text.p: REUTERS EUROPEAN DIARY OF EVENTS FOR ADVERTISING & MEDIA - to June 8
The following is a four-week diary of events covering advertising, marketing, media and the Internet in Europe.
TUESDAY, MAY 13
LONDON - Incentive '97, exhibition for the promotional marketing and incentives industry. Olympia Centre, London. Contact: (44) 1203 426 501 (first day of three-day exhibition)
WEDNESDAY, MAY 14
LONDON - Incentive '97, exhibition for the promotional marketing and incentives industry. Olympia Centre, London. (second day of three-day exhibition)
MUNICH - Advertising Summit, featuring top German media officials, ad agency managers and marketers. Hotel Park Hilton. (first day of two-day conference)
THURSDAY, MAY 15
LONDON - Digital and the Future of Radio & Audio: Where Next for Audio & Radio Data Services? Cafe Royal. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700 or (44) 171 637 4383. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Incentive '97, exhibition for the promotional marketing and incentives industry. Olympia Centre, London. (final day of three-day exhibition)
MUNICH - Advertising Summit, featuring top German media officials, ad agency managers and marketers. Hotel Park Hilton. (second day of two-day conference)
FRIDAY, MAY 16
LONDON - Digital and the Future of Radio & Audio: Where Next for Audio & Radio Data Services? Cafe Royal. (second day of two-day conference)
MONDAY, MAY 19
LONDON - Marjorie Scardino, chief executive of Pearson Plc, addresses Advertising Association's Annual General Meeting luncheon. Savoy Hotel. Contact: Arabella Price (44) 171 828 2771
TUESDAY, MAY 20
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97, National Hall and Conference Centre, Olympia. Contact: (44) 1865 388000 or www.iwuk.com (first day of three-day conference)
LONDON - A New Century in Publishing, Financial Times Conference. Contact: (44) 171 896 2626. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1. Contact: (44) 171 287 5678, fax (44) 171 287 0710. (first day of three-day conference)
WEDNESDAY, MAY 21
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97, (second day of three-day conference)
LONDON - A New Century in Publishing, Financial Times Conference. (second day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Youth Perspective 2, annual youth marketing conference. 0830-1600 GMT, Ministry of Sound, London SE1. Contact: (44) 171 413 4486
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1 (second day of three-day conference)
THURSDAY, MAY 22
LONDON - Internet World UK-Spring 97 (final day of three-day conference)
LONDON - The European Strategy Summit: Digital Terrestrial Television. Marriott Hotel, Grosvenor Square. Contact: (44) 171 453 2700. (first day of two-day conference)
LONDON - Intranets: Key Issues for the Employee Communicator. New Connaught Rooms, 61-65 Queen Street. Contact: (44) 171 405 7811

STOCKHOLM - World Federation of Advertiser's annual general meeting and seminar on Commercial Communications & Self-Regulation in the Baltic Region. Contact: (32) 2 502 5740 (first day of two-day meeting)
LONDON - The Creative Show conference, Business Design Centre, Islington, London N1 (final day of three-day conference)

LONDON - Royal Television Society Programme Awards 1996. RTS President Michael Grade to present awards. Evening hosted by Kirsty Young of Channel 5 News. Grosvenor House Hotel, Park Lane, London W1. Contact: (44) 171 430 1000.
FRIDAY, MAY 23
LONDON - The European Strategy Summitt: Digital Terrestrial Television. Marriott Hotel, Grosvenor Square. (final day of two-day conference)

STOCKHOLM - World Federation of Advertiser's annual general meeting and seminar on Commercial Communications & Self-Regulation in the Baltic Region. Contact: (32) 2 502 5740 (second day of two-day meeting)
TUESDAY, MAY 27
LONDON - Mastering Marketing, an interactive programme presented by Hawksmere on how to maximise and build on marketing potential. Contact: (44) 171 824 8257 (first day of three-day programme)
WEDNESDAY, MAY 28
LONDON - Mastering Marketing, an interactive programme presented by Hawksmere on how to masimise and build on marketing potential. (second day of three-day programme)
THURSDAY, MAY 29
LONDON - Mastering Marketing, an interactive programme presented by Hawksmere on how to masimise and build on marketing potential. (third day of three-day programme)
TUESDAY, JUNE 3
LONDON - Telebusiness 1997, exhibition and conference on computer telephony, call centre and telemarketing. Wembley Exhibition Centre. Contact: (44) 181 201 9888 (first day of three-day conference)
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 4
LONDON - Telebusiness 1997, exhibition and conference on computer telephony, call centre and telemarketing. Wembley Exhibition Centre. (second day of three-day conference)
LONDON - Call to Action: The DRTV and Telemarketing Revolution. Langham Hilton, 1 Portland Place, Regent Street, London W1N. Contact: (44) 171 636 1000.
AMSTERDAM - 2005 and the Altered State of Advertising: Managing the Paradox. Contact: (31) 24323 4471. (first day of three-day conference)
THURSDAY, JUNE 5
LONDON - Telebusiness 1997, exhibition and conference on computer telephony, call centre and telemarketing. Wembley Exhibition Centre. (third day of three-day conference)

AMSTERDAM - 2005 and the Altered State of Advertising: Managing the Paradox. (final day of three-day conference)
